name: Auto-renewal / termination notice

risk_rules.reason: Contract renews automatically with no clear notice window or opt-out mechanism, risking indefinite lock-in.
risk_rules.redline: Add a fixed renewal term with a required written notice period (30-60 days) to cancel before each renewal.

risk_rules.reason: Cancellation notice window is under 30 days, making it easy to miss and get locked into another renewal term.
risk_rules.redline: Extend the notice-to-cancel window to at least 30 days and require it be sent via a trackable method.

default_reason: An auto-renewal clause is present; confirm the notice period and renewal term length manually.
default_redline: Confirm the exact notice period and consider adding a reminder before each renewal deadline.
missing_reason: No auto-renewal clause found -- the contract term appears fixed, which is generally lower risk.

name: Limitation of liability

risk_rules.pattern: unlimited liability|no limitation on liability|shall not be limited|without limitation.{0,40}liability
risk_rules.exclude_pattern: except (?:for|in cases? of)|other than (?:for|in cases? of)|excluding (?:cases? of )?(?:fraud|gross negligence|willful)
risk_rules.reason: Liability is explicitly uncapped or unlimited -- a single incident could create unbounded financial exposure.
risk_rules.redline: Cap total liability at a fixed multiple of fees paid (e.g. 12 months' fees) with standard carve-outs only.

risk_rules.reason: Liability is capped at fees paid, which is a standard and favorable limitation.

default_reason: A liability clause exists but the cap amount or multiplier is unclear from the surrounding text -- verify the exact number.
default_redline: Clarify the liability cap as a specific dollar amount or multiple of fees paid.
missing_reason: No limitation-of-liability clause was found -- without one, liability exposure is effectively uncapped by default in most jurisdictions.

name: Indemnification

risk_rules.reason: Indemnification obligation appears one-sided, exposing this party without a reciprocal obligation from the counterparty.
risk_rules.redline: Make indemnification mutual so both parties bear responsibility for their own breaches, IP claims, and negligence.

risk_rules.reason: Indemnification is mutual, which is the standard, balanced position.

default_reason: An indemnification clause is present; confirm whether the obligation is mutual and what it covers.
default_redline: Confirm the indemnification is mutual and scoped to third-party IP claims, gross negligence, and confidentiality breaches.
missing_reason: No indemnification clause found -- there is no explicit allocation of responsibility for third-party claims.

name: Payment terms

risk_rules.reason: Extended payment terms of 90+ days strain cash flow and are well outside typical B2B norms (net 30-45).
risk_rules.redline: Negotiate payment terms down to net 30 or net 45.

risk_rules.reason: Payment terms exceed the common net 30-45 day norm.
risk_rules.redline: Consider negotiating toward net 30-45 if cash flow timing matters.

default_reason: Payment terms are specified and appear within normal range.
missing_reason: No explicit payment terms (due date, net period) were found -- ambiguity here commonly leads to invoicing disputes.

name: IP ownership / work-for-hire

risk_rules.reason: IP assignment language is broad (perpetual, irrevocable, and/or worldwide) -- confirm it does not extend beyond the specific deliverables under this contract.
risk_rules.redline: Scope IP assignment to deliverables created specifically under this agreement, excluding pre-existing background IP and tools.

default_reason: An IP ownership clause is present and appears scoped to project deliverables, which is standard.
missing_reason: No explicit IP ownership clause found -- default statutory ownership rules would apply, confirm this is acceptable.

name: Confidentiality

risk_rules.reason: Confidentiality obligations survive perpetually/indefinitely with no defined end date.
risk_rules.redline: Cap the confidentiality survival period to 3-5 years after termination, except for trade secrets.

default_reason: A confidentiality clause is present with a bounded scope.
missing_reason: No confidentiality/non-disclosure clause was found -- sensitive information shared under this contract would have no contractual protection.

name: Governing law / venue
detection_pattern: governing law|governed by the laws|exclusive jurisdiction|venue shall be
default_reason: A governing law and venue clause is present.
missing_reason: No governing law or venue clause was found -- a dispute would default to an ambiguous or contested jurisdiction.

name: Data privacy / breach notification

risk_rules.reason: Breach notification window exceeds the common 72-hour standard (e.g. GDPR-aligned practice).
risk_rules.redline: Tighten the breach notification requirement to within 72 hours of discovery.

default_reason: Data privacy / breach notification obligations are present.
missing_reason: No data privacy or breach-notification obligations were found -- a compliance and liability gap for any contract touching customer or personal data.

name: Assignment / change of control

risk_rules.reason: The counterparty may assign this contract to a third party without requiring your consent.
risk_rules.redline: Require prior written consent (not to be unreasonably withheld) before either party can assign the contract.

default_reason: An assignment clause is present and appears to require consent.
missing_reason: No assignment / change-of-control clause found -- default statutory assignment rules would apply.

name: Non-compete / non-solicit

risk_rules.reason: The restrictive covenant applies worldwide with no geographic limitation, which is unusually broad and may be unenforceable while still chilling behavior.
risk_rules.redline: Limit the geographic scope to the specific markets/territories where the business actually operates.

risk_rules.reason: The restrictive covenant duration exceeds 2 years, longer than what is typically enforceable or reasonable.
risk_rules.redline: Shorten the non-compete/non-solicit duration to 12-24 months.

default_reason: A non-compete/non-solicit clause is present; confirm its duration and geographic scope are reasonable.
default_redline: Confirm duration (ideally <=2 years) and geographic scope are narrowly tailored.
